question: Beyond J7O's fair site-1 witness, which other next-record charge bits on the same four action/future cells are algebraically fixed by the complete second measurement, and does that suffice for a complete next law within the existing budget?
role: Prospective exact operator-identity classification and contingent full-law reconstruction, without Born expansion or noisy-schedule evaluation
source_basis: J7M complete second public-law records and selected first record
J7N same-future flux/eligibility and cost audit
J6L/J6M periodic D4 geometry and vacuum orbit
J6N/J7D frozen star and commutator algebra

model.physical_and_public_boundary: The fixed ideal paper-normalized L=2 D4 vacuum orbit, private initial red-X error [0,4,3], same selected first public record of mass 1/4, relation-free public actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], all J7M complete second public outcomes, and two matched private later red-X faults [0],[4]. Only full binary first/second records and declared action are public; physical/future supports and operators are private derivation aids.
model.identity_classes: For each eligible next Hermitian involution B, if it anticommutes with at least one measured second involution A, its charge is fair conditional on every positive complete second prefix. Otherwise, if B equals A or -A for a measured second involution, its charge is respectively equal to or opposite that second charge bit. Otherwise classify unresolved; commutation alone is insufficient to infer its law. Ineligible next sites have fixed charge 0 by the frozen full-binary public schema.
model.contingent_reconstruction: Only if every eligible next site is classified and at most one eligible site is fair, construct the complete next public law for each positive second prefix from deterministic bits and the one fair bit; combine using all J7M second-prefix probabilities, normalize exactly, and compare the two actions at each fixed future key by total variation. If any site is unresolved or two fair sites require a joint correlation, no full law or TV is reported.
model.independent_unit_uncertainty: Deterministic exhaustive four-cell operator audit and exact rational mixture of prior full-second probabilities if reconstruction gate passes; no stochastic independent unit or confidence interval

branches: both actions crossed with both frozen future keys
every next site classified as ineligible, anticommuting fair, exact signed repeat, or unresolved
contingent full-law exact-rational reconstruction and same-future comparison only if the algebraic completeness gate passes

competing_outcomes.all_sites_resolved: At most one fair next site and every other eligible site is an exact signed repeat; a complete next law and same-future total variation follow algebraically without Born expansion.
competing_outcomes.partial_resolution: One or more next sites remain unresolved, or two fair sites have uncomputed correlations; report the exact site classes only and stop before any full-law/TV claim.
competing_outcomes.invalid: Any source pin, public-record, operator-involution, J7O witness, prefix mass, flux, CPU, pair or row gate fails; no classification claim.

acceptance: Seven immutable pins pass before and after; J7M/J7N/J7O provenance and four cells replay
Every next site's class is mutually consistent and all eligible second/next operators are Hermitian involutions
All 68 second-prefix/future combinations retain full public records and exact positive masses
A full next law/TV is constructed only if every site and correlation is resolved; otherwise explicit unresolved sites are reported with no TV
All pair, prefix, row, CPU, zero-Born/noisy/arm/bootstrap and frozen-caller gates pass
stop_rule: Do not upgrade an unresolved commutative site to deterministic or assume independence among multiple fair sites. Do not raise the prior exact-engine term ceiling. Fail closed on any integrity or registered budget gate; no noisy experiment or caller mutation.
